description.value:
You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class. These spells depend on the damage type of your chosen ancestry, as shown in the tables below. The spells count as sorcerer spells for you, but they don't count against the number of sorcerer spells you know.

Draconic Acid Spells
Sorcerer LevelSpells
3rdCreate Or Destroy Water, Tasha's Caustic Brew, Darkvision, Melf's Acid Arrow
5thCorrosion, Hunger of Hadar
7thVitriolic Sphere, Watery Sphere
9thAcid Pit, Passwall
Draconic Cold Spells
Sorcerer LevelSpells
3rdArmor of Agathys, Grease, Rime's Binding Ice, Snilloc's Snowball Swarm
5thSleet Storm, Slow
7thIce Storm, Stoneskin
9thCone of Cold, Hold Monster
Draconic Fire Spells
Sorcerer LevelSpells
3rdBurning Hands, Hellish Rebuke, Heat Metal, Scorching Ray
5thFireball, Flame Stride
7thFire Shield, Wall of Fire
9thFlame Strike, Immolation
Draconic Lightning Spells
Sorcerer LevelSpells
3rdGift of Alacrity, Witch Bolt, Mirror Image, Misty Step
5thHaste, Lightning Bolt
7thFreedom of Movement, Storm Sphere
9thFar Step, Mislead
Draconic Necrotic Spells
Sorcerer LevelSpells
3rdHex, Shadow Ray, Blindness/Deafness, Infirmity
5thBestow Curse, Dark Orb
7thBlight, Shadow of Moil
9thEnervation, Negative Energy Flood
Draconic Poison Spells
Sorcerer LevelSpells
3rdCommand, Ray of Sickness, Protection from Poison, Ray of Enfeeblement
5thStinking Cloud, Tongues
7thDominate Beast, Greater Invisibility
9thCloudkill, Contagion

Sorcerer LevelSpells
3rdBless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration, Zone of Truth
5thDaylight, Mass Healing Word
7thBanishment, Guardian of Faith
9thMass Cure Wounds, Circle of Power
